diagrams.title: **Four red boxes you no longer build
diagrams.caption: **Four red boxes you no longer build.** Intent recognition and parameter extraction move into the model. Your job shrinks to writing a clear function and docstring.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 430" aria-label="Traditional chatbot versus agent. The traditional bot needs an intent classifier trained on examples, a regex to pull out the product ID, a mapping table from phrases to intents, and a handler, all built and maintained by you. The agent only needs the check_inventory tool with its docstring; the model reads it and calls check_inventory with product_id PROD-123." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <text x="20" y="32" class="lab ink-risk" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#8E1F35;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Traditional chatbot: you build every box</text>
      <rect x="20" y="50" width="240" height="160" rx="14" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="36" y="80" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Is PROD-123 in stock?”</text><text x="36" y="108" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Do we have PROD-456…”</text><text x="36" y="136" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Check inventory for…”</text><text x="36" y="164" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Can I order PROD-123…”</text>
      <path d="M260 130 H296" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="300" y="50" width="230" height="70" rx="12" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="316" y="80" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">Intent classifier</text><text x="316" y="104" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">trained on many examples</text>
      <rect x="300" y="140" width="230" height="70" rx="12" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="316" y="170" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">Regex for the ID</text><text x="316" y="194" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:13px">PROD-\d+</text>
      <path d="M530 130 H566" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="570" y="50" width="230" height="160" rx="12" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="586" y="80" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">Phrase → intent map</text>
      <text x="586" y="110" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">“in stock” → CHECK_INV</text><text x="586" y="134" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">“available” → CHECK_INV</text><text x="586" y="158" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">“can I order” → CHECK_INV</text><text x="586" y="182" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">… and every new phrasing</text>
      <path d="M800 130 H836" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="840" y="90" width="240" height="80" rx="12" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="960" y="136" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">handler code</text>
      <line x1="20" y1="244" x2="1080" y2="244" stroke="#D7DCE8" stroke-width="2"></line>
      <text x="20" y="282" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Agent: you write one function with a good docstring</text>
      <rect x="20" y="300" width="240" height="110" rx="14" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="36" y="334" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">any of the four phrasings,</text><text x="36" y="360" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">or a fifth you never</text><text x="36" y="386" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">thought of</text>
      <path d="M260 355 H336" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="340" y="300" width="340" height="110" rx="14" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="360" y="336" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">Model reads the docstring</text>
      <text x="360" y="364" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Check if a product is in stock”</text><text x="360" y="388" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">and pulls out the product ID</text>
      <path d="M680 355 H756" class="ln-tool" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="760" y="318" width="320" height="74" rx="14" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="920" y="362" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px">check_inventory("PROD-123")</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **Same tools, different wiring
diagrams.caption: **Same tools, different wiring.** On the left every call dials the database again. On the right the class holds one open line that every tool method shares.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 400" aria-label="Left: one agent request makes four tool calls, and each opens its own connection to the database, so four connections for one request. Right: an InventoryTools object opens one connection in its constructor; check_stock and update_stock both use that single shared connection, guarded by a lock." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <text x="270" y="32" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Function tools: a connection per call</text>

        <rect x="220" y="100" width="160" height="40" rx="10" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="300" y="126" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:13.5px">check_stock</text>
        <rect x="220" y="150" width="160" height="40" rx="10" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="300" y="176" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:13.5px">update_stock</text>
        <rect x="220" y="200" width="160" height="40" rx="10" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="300" y="226" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:13.5px">check_stock</text>

        <text x="765" y="268" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">both methods use self.db</text>

        <text x="835" y="330" text-anchor="middle" class="tl ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">1 connection</text>

diagrams.title: **Waiting in parallel
diagrams.caption: **Waiting in parallel.** Total time drops from the sum of the calls to the slowest single call. That only works because the three checks are independent.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 340" aria-label="Timeline. Sequentially, east takes 0 to 2 seconds, west 2 to 4, central 4 to 6: 6 seconds total. With async, all three run from 0 to 2 seconds at the same time: about 2 seconds total." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <line x1="160" y1="300" x2="1060" y2="300" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></line>
        <g class="tx" style="font-size:14px;fill:#586082"><text x="160" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">0 s</text><text x="310" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">1 s</text><text x="460" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">2 s</text><text x="610" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">3 s</text><text x="760" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">4 s</text><text x="910" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">5 s</text><text x="1060" y="324" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F">6 s</text></g>
        <g stroke="#D7DCE8" stroke-width="1.5"><line x1="460" y1="30" x2="460" y2="296"></line><line x1="760" y1="30" x2="760" y2="296"></line><line x1="1060" y1="30" x2="1060" y2="296"></line></g>
        <text x="20" y="44" class="lab ink-risk" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#8E1F35;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">One after another</text>
        <text x="20" y="80" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">east</text><rect x="160" y="62" width="300" height="28" rx="6" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="20" y="116" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">west</text><rect x="460" y="98" width="300" height="28" rx="6" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="20" y="152" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">central</text><rect x="760" y="134" width="300" height="28" rx="6" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="1050" y="186" text-anchor="end" class="lab ink-risk" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#8E1F35;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">≈ 6 s</text>
        <text x="20" y="208" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Async, at the same time</text>
        <text x="20" y="240" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">east</text><rect x="160" y="226" width="300" height="20" rx="6" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="20" y="266" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">west</text><rect x="160" y="252" width="300" height="20" rx="6" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="20" y="292" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">central</text><rect x="160" y="278" width="300" height="18" rx="6" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="480" y="270" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">≈ 2 s</text>

diagrams.title: **Let real problems guide you, not theoretical ones
diagrams.caption: **Let real problems guide you, not theoretical ones.** The answers aren't exclusive: a class can hold async tool methods if you have both problems.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 360" aria-label="Decision guide. Start with a plain @tool function. If several tools share an expensive resource, group them in a class. If a tool waits on slow input or output and is called several times at once, make it async. If you need strict input validation, define an explicit tool spec." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="20" y="20" width="520" height="64" rx="32" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="280" y="60" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Start: a plain @tool function</text>
        <path d="M280 84 V112" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <rect x="20" y="116" width="520" height="64" rx="14" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2"></rect>
        <text x="40" y="144" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:17px;font-weight:700">Do several tools share an expensive resource?</text><text x="40" y="168" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">a DB connection, an API client, a login token</text>
        <path d="M540 148 H636" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="588" y="138" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">yes</text>
        <rect x="640" y="116" width="440" height="64" rx="32" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="860" y="155" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Group them in a class</text>
        <path d="M280 180 V208" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="292" y="200" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">no / also</text>
        <rect x="20" y="212" width="520" height="64" rx="14" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2"></rect>
        <text x="40" y="240" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:17px;font-weight:700">Does it wait on slow I/O, many calls at once?</text><text x="40" y="264" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">network APIs, remote services</text>
        <path d="M540 244 H636" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="588" y="234" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">yes</text>
        <rect x="640" y="212" width="440" height="64" rx="32" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="860" y="251" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Make it async</text>
        <path d="M280 276 V292" class="ln" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <rect x="20" y="294" width="520" height="56" rx="14" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2"></rect>
        <text x="40" y="328" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:17px;font-weight:700">Need strict input rules (formats, allowed values)?</text>
        <path d="M540 322 H636" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="588" y="312" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">yes</text>
        <rect x="640" y="294" width="440" height="56" rx="28" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="860" y="328" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Explicit tool spec (TOOL_SPEC)</text>
      </svg>
